ng-2I7W.title: Soil: dark red
ng-2I7W.summary: Dark red soil is most common in and around two southern cities. Lighter red-tinged soil appears in many places, so this means specifically dark red.

ng-3nIu.title: Vehicles: tuk tuk colour depends on state
ng-3nIu.summary: Some states have their own vehicle and tuk tuk colours. The map shows which states have yellow tuk tuks. Rare exceptions exist, and in-game paint can look slightly different.

ng-3ygO.title: Landscape: dry green farmland with corn
ng-3ygO.summary: A dry but green farming landscape with lots of corn points to one northern state, which only has the very low-quality camera, no Gen 3 or 4.

ng-6QNl.title: Coverage: very low quality, blocky blur
ng-6QNl.summary: The only mainland African country with this very low-quality coverage. Coverage from 2023 to 2025 is even worse, with huge cars barely visible through the blur. That level appears elsewhere only in Lebanon.

ng-Fghi.title: Plate: short, greenish through blur
ng-Fghi.summary: Short plates that look somewhat green through the blur. A useful hint when the police car is not visible.

ng-JPLG.title: Landscape: tallest mountains, winding green road
ng-JPLG.summary: A road winding up lush green mountains, the tallest with coverage in the country, in slightly foggy, wet-looking coverage.

ng-Mh2Y.title: Farming: haystacks, in one northern state
ng-Mh2Y.summary: Very common haystacks, almost only seen in one northern state.

ng-N7jK.title: Landscape: flat, hills in a few areas
ng-N7jK.summary: Mostly flat with subtle changes. The south has a few hills in the south-east and south-west, and the north has bigger hills and mountains. The biggest mountains are in the east but are rarely visible.

ng-P6Jg.title: Landscape: monolithic rock hills, weathered
ng-P6Jg.summary: Huge rock mountains with exposed, weathered stone around the capital.

ng-PVr3.title: Google car: old Gen 3 follow cars, by area
ng-PVr3.summary: Different old Gen 3 follow cars appear in different areas. They are uncommon but useful. A silver Lexus rarely appears on one eastern highway.

ng-PoWp.title: Road: no lines, potholes, unpaved roads
ng-PoWp.summary: Roads are often poorly kept: no road lines or faded ones are common, as are potholes, cracks and unpaved roads.

ng-Pu6a.title: Landscape: lush grass, red soil, thatched huts
ng-Pu6a.summary: Lush green grass-covered ground with reddish soil, scattered taller trees and few shrubs. Thatched huts are common. Lots of palms means a neighbouring southern state instead.

ng-QcE0.title: Road: divided highway, Gen 4, open arid land
ng-QcE0.summary: A divided highway in Gen 4 coverage through mostly open, dry land, heading east of one north-eastern town toward the state border.

ng-UAra.title: Landscape: scattered trees, red soil, dry grass
ng-UAra.summary: A middle state covered almost entirely by the very low-quality camera, with scattered trees, reddish soil and dry grass. It looks like the nearby grass-and-red-soil state.

ng-YLLW.title: Coverage: sparse, mainly cities and highways
ng-YLLW.summary: Coverage is sparse, with very few roads in the north-west and east. Most of it is around big cities and the highways between them.

ng-ZNLu.title: Houses: single-storey, steep metal roofs
ng-ZNLu.summary: Mostly one-floor houses with steep roofs, usually metal sheets, and cinder block walls around the yard.

ng-ZihY.title: Religion: Christian south, Muslim north
ng-ZihY.summary: Mainly Christian in the south and Muslim in the north, so women in hijabs and men in Muslim dress are more common in the north.

ng-c2cO.title: Google car: no Gen 4 in north-west or far south
ng-c2cO.summary: Gen 4 is not found in the north-west or the far south. The very low-quality camera now covers most of the country.

ng-eIgz.title: Plants: rainforest south to dry steppe north
ng-eIgz.summary: Climate runs from tropical rainforest with lots of palms in the far south, to savannah with scattered trees in the centre, to dry steppe in the far north. Wet and dry seasons can make coverage greener or drier than expected.

ng-eMZn.title: Google car: pickup truck, cab and bed visible
ng-eMZn.summary: Most coverage shows a pickup truck with its cab and bed in view. Cab colour varies. Gen 3 has a roof rack, and sometimes the whole truck is hidden by one big blur.

ng-hCzH.title: Google car: Gen 3 only south of the capital
ng-hCzH.summary: Knowing where each camera generation exists helps. Gen 3 is not found north of the capital Abuja.

ng-hvhF.title: Coverage: low-quality camera with blue tint
ng-hvhF.summary: A version of the very low-quality coverage with a distinct blue tint, found only in certain areas.

ng-lm-2588.title: Google car: black or wine-red SUV, no markings
ng-lm-2588.summary: In one southern city, the follow cars are two unmarked Toyota SUVs, one black and one wine red, with no police markings.

ng-lm-446337.title: Landscape: dry hazy Gen 3 road, smudge on camera
ng-lm-446337.summary: A dry, hazy, slightly gloomy Gen 3 road with big mountains in the distance, and a smudge on the front of the camera that gets darker further north. Coverage is broken in places.

ng-lrDl.title: Signs: place names on shops and banners
ng-lrDl.summary: City and state names often appear on storefronts and banners, so knowing them helps.

ng-op6f.title: Landscape: savannah with rocky hills
ng-op6f.summary: In the north-east: savannah with rocky hills. Hills at the far east and west are greener than those in the middle. Near one city the hills are softer, clay-like soil.

ng-pXX3.title: Landscape: flat, sandy, palms, silver follow car
ng-pXX3.summary: A flat, sandy, coastal area with many palms, mostly old Gen 3 coverage with a silver follow car.

ng-qoOw.title: Landscape: very open, arid, almost treeless
ng-qoOw.summary: Highways in the north-west are even more open and dry than in the middle belt. Trees become rare or absent, and it is all low-quality coverage.

ng-xB4U.title: Pole: concrete with dents and cross supports
ng-xB4U.summary: Mostly concrete poles with indents and a few horizontal supports. They look like Brazil's, but have no holes through them.

differs.how: Brazilian poles have holes through them

ng-xTa2.title: Road: lush divided highway, short median, trucks
ng-xTa2.summary: A major highway through lush tropical plants, divided by a short concrete median, with many trucks. Another divided highway has a noticeably wider median.

ng-yfEi.title: Google car: police car following behind
ng-yfEi.summary: A white or black police car almost always follows the Street View car and shows behind it. It can occasionally be missing, so don't rule the country out if you don't see it.
